hooks.name: h4-physics-guard-checks
hooks.description: H4a: when signal-processing or experiment source is saved, type-check units and run the property-based tests. Cheap command action; failures are passed to the agent.

hooks.name: h4-physics-guard-review
hooks.description: H4b: when an experiment's theory, analysis or uncertainty file is saved, review it for missing units, uncertainty, method and assumptions. Agent action (uses credits), so it only watches experiment physics files.

action.prompt: Physics guard (hook H4b). An experiment physics file was just saved. Review ONLY that file against .kiro/steering/physics.md and .kiro/steering/units.md. Check: (1) every physical value in exported signatures uses Quantity<U> from seance-core/units, not bare number; (2) every result returned to the app has value, uncertainty, unit, method and assumptions; (3) every formula has a comment naming its source and validity range (e.g. small-angle pendulum, Euler-Bernoulli first mode); (4) uncertainty propagation matches the formula (relative errors in quadrature with the right powers); (5) theory functions are pure. If everything passes, reply with one line: 'Physics guard: OK'. If not, list each problem with the line number and a one-line fix, and apply only fixes that do not change the public API. Do not edit other files. If you add or change a theory function, remind the user that hook H8 will refresh the notebook template.
